text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- A strike by lorry drivers in France is affecting Portuguese exports.
- Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) is negotiating to buy from Banco Comercial Portugues/Banco Portugues do Atlantico (BCP/BPA) the branches of Banco Comercial de Macau, the paper learned.

- U.S. bank Wachovia Bank of Georgia is negotiating to buy Banco Portugues do Atlantico's Brazil subsidiary from BPA, a source involved in the process told the paper. The deal could be worth some $50 million.
- Natural gas distrubutor Transgas was valued at some 40 billion escudos, a source involved in the evaluation told the paper.
- Workers at a Grundig factory in northern Portugal blocked the Oporto-Braga highway for an hour yesterday in a protest against the threatened loss of their jobs.
- UEFA tried to obstruct Portuguese state television channel RTP from showing images of scuffles after the European Champions' League match between Porto and AC Milan this week.
